\subsubsection*{Adopted relations}

\paragraph{eos}
State equation (equation). Ideal gas with a fixed specific gas constant.
\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
P(z)=\rho(z)R T(z)
\end{aligned}
\label{eq:example.isothermal_5f_atmosphere_3a_atmosphere:eos:1}
\end{equation}
\noindent\textbf{Definition:} ideal\_gas (revision 1).
\textbf{Scope:} Gas pressure and mass density of the same atmosphere at the same height.

\begin{description}
\item[$P$] P $\mapsto$ pressure. Gas pressure
\item[$R$] R $\mapsto$ gas\_constant. Specific gas constant
\item[$T$] T $\mapsto$ temperature. Gas temperature
\item[$\rho$] rho $\mapsto$ density. Mass density
\item[$z$] z $\mapsto$ height. Height
\end{description}

\noindent\textbf{Assumptions:}
\begin{itemize}
\item Composition is fixed.
\end{itemize}

\paragraph{balance}
Mechanical balance (equation). Gas-pressure support against constant downward gravity.
\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
\frac{dP}{dz}=-\rho(z)g
\end{aligned}
\label{eq:example.isothermal_5f_atmosphere_3a_atmosphere:balance:1}
\end{equation}
\noindent\textbf{Definition:} hydrostatic\_balance (revision 1).
\textbf{Scope:} A static plane-parallel atmosphere with height increasing upward.

\begin{description}
\item[$P$] P $\mapsto$ pressure. Gas pressure
\item[$g$] g $\mapsto$ gravity. Positive gravity magnitude
\item[$\rho$] rho $\mapsto$ density. Mass density
\item[$z$] z $\mapsto$ height. Height
\end{description}

\noindent\textbf{Assumptions:}
\begin{itemize}
\item Other pressure components and acceleration are omitted.
\end{itemize}

\paragraph{temperature\_closure}
Prescribed temperature (equation). Prescribe a constant gas temperature.
\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
T(z)=T_0
\end{aligned}
\label{eq:example.isothermal_5f_atmosphere_3a_atmosphere:temperature_5f_closure:1}
\end{equation}
\noindent\textbf{Definition:} isothermal\_closure (revision 1).
\textbf{Scope:} The entire declared atmospheric domain.

\begin{description}
\item[$T$] T $\mapsto$ temperature. Gas temperature
\item[$T_0$] T0 $\mapsto$ fixed\_temperature. Supplied constant temperature
\item[$z$] z $\mapsto$ height. Height
\end{description}

\paragraph{pressure\_boundary}
Boundary condition (equation). Specify pressure at the reference height.
\begin{equation}
\begin{aligned}
P(0)=P_0
\end{aligned}
\label{eq:example.isothermal_5f_atmosphere_3a_atmosphere:pressure_5f_boundary:1}
\end{equation}
\noindent\textbf{Definition:} base\_pressure (revision 1).
\textbf{Scope:} The boundary z=0 of the same pressure field used in the interior.

\begin{description}
\item[$P$] P $\mapsto$ pressure. Gas pressure field
\item[$P_0$] P0 $\mapsto$ base\_pressure. Supplied boundary pressure
\end{description}
